name: view_chart_monthly_users
viewQuery:
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%m', chart.data) AS id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', chart.data) AS month, 
    date(chart.data, 'start of month') AS start_date, 
    date(chart.data, 'start of month', '+1 month', '-1 day') AS end_date, 
    COUNT(*) AS users 
FROM chart 
WHERE chart.chart = "users_login" 
GROUP BY month 
ORDER BY month ASC;

name: view_chart_state_stats_total
viewQuery:
SELECT 
    positions.state as id,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events INNER JOIN positions as pos ON events.position = pos.id WHERE pos.state = positions.state) as total_events,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events INNER JOIN positions as pos ON events.position = pos.id WHERE pos.state = positions.state AND events.is_spot = FALSE AND events.is_national = FALSE) as state_events,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events INNER JOIN positions as pos ON events.position = pos.id WHERE pos.state = positions.state AND events.is_spot = TRUE AND events.is_national = FALSE) as spot_events,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events INNER JOIN positions as pos ON events.position = pos.id WHERE pos.state = positions.state AND events.is_national = TRUE) as national_events,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals INNER JOIN positions as pos ON deals.position = pos.id WHERE pos.state = positions.state) as available_deals,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users_metadata WHERE instr(users_metadata.value, positions.state) > 0 AND users_metadata.key = 'notify_me_events') as notifiable_users
FROM 
    positions
GROUP BY 
    positions.state
ORDER BY
    total_events DESC

name: view_chart_state_stats_yearly
viewQuery:
SELECT 
    positions.state as id,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events INNER JOIN positions as pos ON events.position = pos.id WHERE pos.state = positions.state AND events.when_start > DATE('2025-01-01')) as total_events,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events INNER JOIN positions as pos ON events.position = pos.id WHERE pos.state = positions.state AND events.when_start > DATE('2025-01-01') AND events.is_spot = FALSE AND events.is_national = FALSE) as state_events,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events INNER JOIN positions as pos ON events.position = pos.id WHERE pos.state = positions.state AND events.when_start > DATE('2025-01-01') AND events.is_spot = TRUE AND events.is_national = FALSE) as spot_events,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events INNER JOIN positions as pos ON events.position = pos.id WHERE pos.state = positions.state AND events.when_start > DATE('2025-01-01') AND events.is_national = TRUE) as national_events,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals INNER JOIN positions as pos ON deals.position = pos.id WHERE pos.state = positions.state) as available_deals,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users_metadata WHERE instr(users_metadata.value, positions.state) > 0 AND users_metadata.key = 'notify_me_events') as notifiable_users
FROM 
    positions
GROUP BY 
    positions.state
ORDER BY
    total_events DESC

name: view_chart_weekly_users
viewQuery:
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%W', chart.data) AS id,
    strftime('%Y-%W', chart.data) AS week, 
    date(chart.data, 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS start_date, 
    date(chart.data, 'weekday 0') AS end_date,

FROM chart 
WHERE chart.chart = "users_login"

ORDER BY week ASC;

name: view_leaderboard
viewQuery:
SELECT
  u.id AS id,
  u.name AS name,
  CAST(r.position AS INTEGER) AS position,
  CAST(r.score AS INTEGER) AS score,
  CAST(r.stamps_points AS INTEGER) AS stamps_points,
  CAST(r.medal_points AS INTEGER) AS medal_points,
  CAST(r.events_points AS INTEGER) AS events_points,
  CAST(r.stamps_total AS INTEGER) AS stamps_total,
  CAST(r.stamps_distinct_regions AS INTEGER) AS stamps_distinct_regions
FROM users u
JOIN (
  -- Le parti sono arrotondate prima di sommarle e ordinarle: cosi' a pari
  -- punti mostrati la posizione e' la stessa e le tre parti sommano al totale.
  SELECT s.*, s.stamps_points + s.events_points + s.medal_points AS score,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.stamps_points + s.events_points + s.medal_points DESC) AS position
  FROM (
    SELECT
      m.id AS uid,
      ROUND(COALESCE(d.points, 0)) AS stamps_points,
      m.stamps_total, m.stamps_distinct_regions,
      -- Medaglie, come in MedalRules dell'app: bronzo 3, argento 5, oro 10,
      -- platino 20, quelle a livello unico 8. Fuori: "organizer" e
      -- "national_director" (gli eventi organizzati hanno gia' i loro punti
      -- piu' sotto) e "traveller" (stamps_out_of_region e' rotto:
      -- members_registry.state e' la provincia).
        CASE WHEN m.stamps_total >= 250 THEN 20 WHEN m.stamps_total >= 100 THEN 10 WHEN m.stamps_total >= 25 THEN 5 WHEN m.stamps_total >= 1 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_distinct_months >= 24 THEN 20 WHEN m.stamps_distinct_months >= 12 THEN 10 WHEN m.stamps_distinct_months >= 6 THEN 5 WHEN m.stamps_distinct_months >= 3 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_max_month_streak >= 24 THEN 20 WHEN m.stamps_max_month_streak >= 12 THEN 10 WHEN m.stamps_max_month_streak >= 6 THEN 5 WHEN m.stamps_max_month_streak >= 3 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_max_same_day >= 8 THEN 20 WHEN m.stamps_max_same_day >= 5 THEN 10 WHEN m.stamps_max_same_day >= 3 THEN 5 WHEN m.stamps_max_same_day >= 2 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_max_seasons_in_year >= 4 THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_pioneer >= 30 THEN 20 WHEN m.stamps_pioneer >= 15 THEN 10 WHEN m.stamps_pioneer >= 5 THEN 5 WHEN m.stamps_pioneer >= 1 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_distinct_regions >= 20 THEN 20 WHEN m.stamps_distinct_regions >= 10 THEN 10 WHEN m.stamps_distinct_regions >= 5 THEN 5 WHEN m.stamps_distinct_regions >= 2 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_national >= 10 THEN 20 WHEN m.stamps_national >= 5 THEN 10 WHEN m.stamps_national >= 3 THEN 5 WHEN m.stamps_national >= 1 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_night >= 1 THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_morning >= 1 THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_halloween >= 1 THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_new_year >= 1 THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_valentine >= 1 THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_pi_day >= 1 THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_birthday >= 1 THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_first_day >= 1 THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.stamps_late >= 1 THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.event_registrations >= 50 THEN 20 WHEN m.event_registrations >= 25 THEN 10 WHEN m.event_registrations >= 10 THEN 5 WHEN m.event_registrations >= 1 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.is_membership_active THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(m.app_since)) / 365 >= 5 THEN 20 WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(m.app_since)) / 365 >= 3 THEN 10 WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(m.app_since)) / 365 >= 2 THEN 5 WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(m.app_since)) / 365 >= 1 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.calendar_linked THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.calendar_regions >= 10 THEN 20 WHEN m.calendar_regions >= 5 THEN 10 WHEN m.calendar_regions >= 3 THEN 5 WHEN m.calendar_regions >= 1 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN m.devices >= 2 THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
      AS medal_points,
      ROUND(COALESCE(ev.points, 0)) AS events_points
    FROM view_medals m
    JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = m.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      -- Timbri: fino a 20 punti ciascuno, secondo la quota di soci della
      -- regione dell'evento che l'ha preso (organizzatore escluso):
      -- s = timbratori / (N_r^0,7 * Nmedia^0,3), con N_r i soci attivi della
      -- regione e Nmedia quelli di una regione media. L'esponente 0,7
      -- perche' l'affluenza non cresce in proporzione ai soci: il
      -- denominatore cresce meno che linearmente con la regione. Sotto il 2%
      -- niente, dal 15% tutto, in mezzo una S (smoothstep t^2 (3 - 2t), con
      -- t = (s - 2%) / 13%) che vale meta' all'8,5%. Le soglie sono quote
      -- dei soci della regione, quindi lo stesso numero di timbratori pesa
      -- diversamente in regioni di dimensione diversa. Scende a zero in 12
      -- mesi (24 se l'evento e' nazionale).
      SELECT user, SUM(20.0 * decay * t * t * (3 - 2 * t) * community) AS points
      FROM (
        SELECT c.user, c.decay,
          MIN(1.0, MAX(0.0, (cnt.claimers / (POWER(COALESCE(reg.active, nb.avg_active), 0.7) * POWER(nb.avg_active, 0.3)) - 0.02) / 0.13)) AS t,
          -- comunita' della regione (view_leaderboard_regioni): quanto e'
          -- ampia, rispetto ai soci, la comunita' che timbra ai suoi eventi.
          -- Eventi nazionali e senza regione: 1.
          COALESCE(rc.community_pct, 100) / 100.0 AS community
        FROM (
          SELECT su.id, su.user, su.stamp, su.created, e.position, e.owner, COALESCE(e.is_national, 0) AS is_national,
            MAX(0, 1 - (julianday('now') - julianday(su.created))
                   / CASE WHEN e.is_national THEN 730 ELSE 365 END) AS decay,
            -- ogni timbro va all'edizione con quel nome piu' vicina nel tempo
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.id
                               ORDER BY abs(julianday(su.created) - julianday(e.when_start))) AS nearest
          FROM stamp_users su
          JOIN stamp st ON st.id = su.stamp
          LEFT JOIN events e ON e.name = st.description
        ) c
        JOIN (
          -- soci che hanno preso quel timbro, esclusi chi ne ha organizzato
          -- l'edizione e 5366, l'account che prende ogni timbro
          SELECT stamp, COUNT(*) AS claimers
          FROM (
            SELECT su.stamp, su.user, e.owner,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.id
                                 ORDER BY abs(julianday(su.created) - julianday(e.when_start))) AS nearest
            FROM stamp_users su
            JOIN stamp st ON st.id = su.stamp
            LEFT JOIN events e ON e.name = st.description
            WHERE su.user != '' AND su.user != '5366'
          )
          WHERE nearest = 1 AND COALESCE(owner, '') != user
          GROUP BY stamp
        ) cnt ON cnt.stamp = c.stamp
        LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = c.position
        LEFT JOIN (
          -- Soci attivi per regione, dal registro soci (members_registry
          -- .is_active e .area), app o non app, con gli stessi accorpamenti
          -- degli eventi.
          SELECT CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END AS region,
                 COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active
          FROM members_registry mr
          WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
          GROUP BY 1
        ) reg ON reg.region = CASE p.state WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE p.state END AND NOT c.is_national
        CROSS JOIN (
          -- Soci di una regione media: entrano nel denominatore con
          -- esponente 0,3, per gli eventi nazionali e senza regione fanno
          -- anche da N_r.
          SELECT AVG(active) AS avg_active FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active FROM members_registry mr
            WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
            GROUP BY CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END)
        ) nb
        LEFT JOIN view_leaderboard_regioni rc ON rc.region_key = CASE p.state WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE p.state END AND NOT c.is_national
        -- chi ha organizzato quell'edizione non prende punti dal suo timbro,
        -- le edizioni di altri, prima o dopo la sua, contano come a tutti
        WHERE c.nearest = 1 AND COALESCE(c.owner, '') != c.user
          -- lo staff regionale (local_offices_admins, segretari e collaboratori)
          -- non prende punti dai timbri degli eventi della propria regione,
          -- finche' e' in carica, gli eventi che organizza gli danno E. I
          -- nomi delle sedi non coincidono con positions.state: mappati qui.
          AND NOT (NOT c.is_national AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM local_offices_admins la JOIN local_offices lo ON lo.id = la.local_office
            WHERE la.user = c.user
              AND CASE lo.region WHEN 'Basilicata e Puglia' THEN 'Puglia' WHEN 'Piemonte e Val d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Emilia Romagna' THEN 'Emilia-Romagna' WHEN 'Friuli Venezia Giulia' THEN 'Friuli-Venezia Giulia' WHEN 'Trentino Alto Adige' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' ELSE lo.region END
                  = CASE p.state WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE p.state END))
      )
      GROUP BY user
    ) d ON d.user = m.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      -- Eventi organizzati: fino a 10 punti ciascuno, con la stessa S sulla
      -- quota di soci della regione timbratori e la stessa scadenza, 12 mesi
      -- dalla data dell'evento, 24 se nazionale.
      SELECT owner, SUM(10.0 * decay * t * t * (3 - 2 * t) * community) AS points
      FROM (
        SELECT e.owner,
          MAX(0, 1 - MAX(0, julianday('now') - julianday(e.when_start))
                 / CASE WHEN e.is_national THEN 730 ELSE 365 END) AS decay,
          MIN(1.0, MAX(0.0, (cnt.claimers / (POWER(COALESCE(reg.active, nb.avg_active), 0.7) * POWER(nb.avg_active, 0.3)) - 0.02) / 0.13)) AS t,
          -- comunita' della regione, come per i timbri
          COALESCE(rc.community_pct, 100) / 100.0 AS community
        FROM events e
        JOIN (
          -- ogni timbro preso va all'evento con quel nome piu' vicino nel
          -- tempo, esclusi l'organizzatore e 5366, che prende ogni timbro
          SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS claimers
          FROM (
            SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.owner, su.user,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.id
                                 ORDER BY abs(julianday(su.created) - julianday(e.when_start))) AS nearest
            FROM stamp_users su
            JOIN stamp st ON st.id = su.stamp
            JOIN events e ON e.name = st.description
            WHERE su.user != '' AND su.user != '5366'
          )
          WHERE nearest = 1 AND owner != user
          GROUP BY event_id
        ) cnt ON cnt.event_id = e.id
        LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = e.position
        LEFT JOIN (
          -- Soci attivi per regione, dal registro soci (members_registry
          -- .is_active e .area), app o non app, con gli stessi accorpamenti
          -- degli eventi.
          SELECT CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END AS region,
                 COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active
          FROM members_registry mr
          WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
          GROUP BY 1
        ) reg ON reg.region = CASE p.state WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE p.state END AND NOT e.is_national
        CROSS JOIN (
          -- Soci di una regione media: entrano nel denominatore con
          -- esponente 0,3, per gli eventi nazionali e senza regione fanno
          -- anche da N_r.
          SELECT AVG(active) AS avg_active FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active FROM members_registry mr
            WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
            GROUP BY CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END)
        ) nb
        LEFT JOIN view_leaderboard_regioni rc ON rc.region_key = CASE p.state WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE p.state END AND NOT e.is_national
        WHERE e.when_start != ''
      )
      GROUP BY owner
    ) ev ON ev.owner = m.id
    WHERE m.is_membership_active
      AND m.id != '5366'
      AND COALESCE(u2.access_level, '') != 'blocked'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stamp_users su WHERE su.user = m.id)
      -- fuori chi ha scelto di non apparire (users_metadata, chiave
      -- leaderboard_hidden = true, impostata dall'app): la riga non viene
      -- calcolata, gli altri salgono di posizione
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users_metadata um
                      WHERE um.user = m.id AND um.key = 'leaderboard_hidden' AND um.value = 'true')
  ) s
) r ON r.uid = u.id

name: view_leaderboard_regioni
viewQuery:
-- Classifica delle regioni (una riga per sede, local_offices).
-- Punteggio = partecipazione x comunita' + nazionali ospitati.
-- Partecipazione: gli eventi non nazionali degli ultimi 12 mesi che si sono
-- svolti nella regione, da chiunque organizzati, con la stessa S della
-- classifica soci sulla quota di soci timbratori (s = timbratori /
-- (N_r^0,7 * Nmedia^0,3), con N_r i soci attivi del registro nella regione e
-- Nmedia quelli di una regione media: zero sotto il 2%, meta' all'8,5%,
-- tutto dal 15%) e la stessa scadenza lineare a 12 mesi. Ogni evento vale
-- fino a 10 punti, come la E della classifica soci.
-- Comunita': quanto e' ampia, rispetto ai soci della regione, la comunita'
-- che timbra ai suoi eventi. I soci "effettivi" sono
-- (somma timbri)^2 / somma(timbri^2): quanti sarebbero se tutti timbrassero
-- lo stesso numero di volte (vale il numero dei timbratori se ognuno timbra
-- una volta, tende a 1 se timbra sempre uno solo). La loro quota sulla
-- regione passa nella stessa S, con lo stesso denominatore: c = 1 dal 15%.
-- Nazionali ospitati: gli eventi nazionali che si sono svolti nella regione
-- negli ultimi 24 mesi, con la stessa formula (10 punti max, stessa S sui
-- timbratori, scadenza a 24 mesi come nella classifica soci) ma fuori dal
-- fattore comunita': un convegno porta gente da tutta Italia, e la curva
-- satura da sola (56-103 timbratori).
-- La classifica soci legge community_pct da qui per pesare i timbri e gli
-- eventi organizzati di ogni regione, region_key e' il nome della regione
-- come in positions.state (accorpato), per quel join.
-- Timbratori: timbro -> edizione piu' vicina nel tempo, senza l'organizzatore
-- di quell'edizione e senza 5366, l'account che prende ogni timbro.
-- Le sedi che coprono due regioni contano come una (vedi i CASE), i nomi
-- delle sedi (local_offices.region) non coincidono con positions.state e
-- vengono mappati. avg_share_pct e' la quota vera, timbratori / soci della
-- regione, in media sugli eventi.
SELECT
  lo.id AS id,
  lo.name AS name,
  lo.region AS region,
  -- PocketBase accetta come colonna solo identificatori o CAST(...): il
  -- CASE nudo non passa il parser della vista
  CAST(CASE lo.region WHEN 'Basilicata e Puglia' THEN 'Puglia' WHEN 'Piemonte e Val d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Emilia Romagna' THEN 'Emilia-Romagna' WHEN 'Friuli Venezia Giulia' THEN 'Friuli-Venezia Giulia' WHEN 'Trentino Alto Adige' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' ELSE lo.region END AS TEXT) AS region_key,
  -- La posizione dipende solo dai punti mostrati: a pari punti, pari
  -- posizione. DENSE_RANK perche' le posizioni 1, 2 e 3 esistano sempre e
  -- le tre medaglie vengano assegnate anche con un pari merito. L'ordine
  -- dentro un pari merito lo decide l'app (partecipazione, poi eventi).
  CAST(DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ROUND(COALESCE(r.score, 0) * COALESCE(d.community, 0) + COALESCE(n.score, 0)) DESC) AS INTEGER) AS position,
  CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(r.score, 0) * COALESCE(d.community, 0) + COALESCE(n.score, 0)) AS INTEGER) AS score,
  CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(r.score, 0)) AS INTEGER) AS participation,
  CAST(ROUND(100 * COALESCE(d.community, 0)) AS INTEGER) AS community_pct,
  CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(n.score, 0)) AS INTEGER) AS national_points,
  CAST(COALESCE(n.events_total, 0) AS INTEGER) AS national_events,
  CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(d.effective_attendees, 0)) AS INTEGER) AS effective_attendees,
  CAST(COALESCE(d.distinct_attendees, 0) AS INTEGER) AS distinct_attendees,
  CAST(ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(d.effective_attendees, 0) / MAX(COALESCE(reg.active, 0), 1)) AS INTEGER) AS core_pct,
  CAST(ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(d.distinct_attendees, 0) / MAX(COALESCE(reg.active, 0), 1)) AS INTEGER) AS reach_pct,
  CAST(COALESCE(r.events_total, 0) AS INTEGER) AS events_total,
  CAST(COALESCE(r.events_scoring, 0) AS INTEGER) AS events_scoring,
  CAST(COALESCE(r.attendance_total, 0) AS INTEGER) AS attendance_total,
  CAST(COALESCE(reg.active, 0) AS INTEGER) AS members_active,
  CAST(ROUND(100 * COALESCE(r.avg_share, 0)) AS INTEGER) AS avg_share_pct
FROM local_offices lo
LEFT JOIN (
  -- Soci attivi per regione, dal registro soci, con gli accorpamenti.
  SELECT CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END AS region,
         COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active
  FROM members_registry mr
  WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
  GROUP BY 1
) reg ON reg.region = CASE lo.region WHEN 'Basilicata e Puglia' THEN 'Puglia' WHEN 'Piemonte e Val d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Emilia Romagna' THEN 'Emilia-Romagna' WHEN 'Friuli Venezia Giulia' THEN 'Friuli-Venezia Giulia' WHEN 'Trentino Alto Adige' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' ELSE lo.region END
LEFT JOIN (
  -- Partecipazione: un punteggio per evento, sommato per regione.
  SELECT region,
    SUM(10.0 * decay * t * t * (3 - 2 * t)) AS score,
    COUNT(*) AS events_total,
    SUM(t > 0) AS events_scoring,
    SUM(claimers) AS attendance_total,
    AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM (
    SELECT x.region, x.decay, x.claimers, x.share,
      MIN(1.0, MAX(0.0, (x.share_eff - 0.02) / 0.13)) AS t
    FROM (
      SELECT CASE p.state WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE p.state END AS region,
        1 - (julianday('now') - julianday(e.when_start)) / 365 AS decay,
        COALESCE(cnt.claimers, 0) AS claimers,
        COALESCE(cnt.claimers, 0) / reg.active AS share,
        COALESCE(cnt.claimers, 0) / (POWER(reg.active, 0.7) * POWER(nb.avg_active, 0.3)) AS share_eff
      FROM events e
      JOIN positions p ON p.id = e.position
      JOIN (
        SELECT CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END AS region,
               COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active
        FROM members_registry mr
        WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
        GROUP BY 1
      ) reg ON reg.region = CASE p.state WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE p.state END
      CROSS JOIN (
        -- Soci di una regione media, nel denominatore con esponente 0,3.
        SELECT AVG(active) AS avg_active FROM (
          SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active FROM members_registry mr
          WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
          GROUP BY CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END)
      ) nb
      LEFT JOIN (
        -- timbratori: ogni timbro preso va all'evento con quel nome piu' vicino
        -- nel tempo, non contano chi ha organizzato quell'edizione e 5366,
        -- l'account che prende ogni timbro
        SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS claimers
        FROM (
          SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.owner, su.user,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.id
                               ORDER BY abs(julianday(su.created) - julianday(e.when_start))) AS nearest
          FROM stamp_users su
          JOIN stamp st ON st.id = su.stamp
          JOIN events e ON e.name = st.description
          WHERE su.user != '' AND su.user != '5366'
        )
        WHERE nearest = 1 AND owner != user
        GROUP BY event_id
      ) cnt ON cnt.event_id = e.id
      WHERE NOT e.is_national
        AND e.when_start != ''
        AND julianday(e.when_start) <= julianday('now')
        AND julianday(e.when_start) > julianday('now', '-365 days')
    ) x
  )
  GROUP BY region
) r ON r.region = CASE lo.region WHEN 'Basilicata e Puglia' THEN 'Puglia' WHEN 'Piemonte e Val d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Emilia Romagna' THEN 'Emilia-Romagna' WHEN 'Friuli Venezia Giulia' THEN 'Friuli-Venezia Giulia' WHEN 'Trentino Alto Adige' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' ELSE lo.region END
LEFT JOIN (
  -- Nazionali ospitati: 10 x decay a 24 mesi x S sui timbratori, senza comunita'.
  SELECT region,
    SUM(10.0 * decay * t * t * (3 - 2 * t)) AS score,
    COUNT(*) AS events_total
  FROM (
    SELECT x.region, x.decay,
      MIN(1.0, MAX(0.0, (x.share_eff - 0.02) / 0.13)) AS t
    FROM (
      SELECT CASE p.state WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE p.state END AS region,
        1 - (julianday('now') - julianday(e.when_start)) / 730 AS decay,
        COALESCE(cnt.claimers, 0) / (POWER(reg.active, 0.7) * POWER(nb.avg_active, 0.3)) AS share_eff
      FROM events e
      JOIN positions p ON p.id = e.position
      JOIN (
        SELECT CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END AS region,
               COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active
        FROM members_registry mr
        WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
        GROUP BY 1
      ) reg ON reg.region = CASE p.state WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE p.state END
      CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT AVG(active) AS avg_active FROM (
          SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active FROM members_registry mr
          WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
          GROUP BY CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END)
      ) nb
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS claimers
        FROM (
          SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.owner, su.user,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.id
                               ORDER BY abs(julianday(su.created) - julianday(e.when_start))) AS nearest
          FROM stamp_users su
          JOIN stamp st ON st.id = su.stamp
          JOIN events e ON e.name = st.description
          WHERE su.user != '' AND su.user != '5366'
        )
        WHERE nearest = 1 AND owner != user
        GROUP BY event_id
      ) cnt ON cnt.event_id = e.id
      WHERE e.is_national
        AND e.when_start != ''
        AND julianday(e.when_start) <= julianday('now')
        AND julianday(e.when_start) > julianday('now', '-730 days')
    ) x
  )
  GROUP BY region
) n ON n.region = CASE lo.region WHEN 'Basilicata e Puglia' THEN 'Puglia' WHEN 'Piemonte e Val d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Emilia Romagna' THEN 'Emilia-Romagna' WHEN 'Friuli Venezia Giulia' THEN 'Friuli-Venezia Giulia' WHEN 'Trentino Alto Adige' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' ELSE lo.region END
LEFT JOIN (
  -- Comunita': soci effettivi tra i timbratori, in quota alla regione, nella S.
  SELECT region, distinct_attendees, effective_attendees,
    t * t * (3 - 2 * t) AS community
  FROM (
    SELECT region, distinct_attendees, effective_attendees,
      MIN(1.0, MAX(0.0, (effective_attendees / (POWER(active, 0.7) * POWER(avg_active, 0.3)) - 0.02) / 0.13)) AS t
    FROM (
      SELECT a.region,
        COUNT(*) AS distinct_attendees,
        (SUM(n) * SUM(n) * 1.0) / SUM(n * n) AS effective_attendees,
        reg.active,
        nb.avg_active
      FROM (
        -- timbri per persona agli eventi regionali degli ultimi 12 mesi
        SELECT region, user, COUNT(*) AS n
        FROM (
          SELECT x.user, CASE p.state WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE p.state END AS region
          FROM (
            SELECT su.user, e.owner, e.position, e.is_national, e.when_start,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.id
                                 ORDER BY abs(julianday(su.created) - julianday(e.when_start))) AS nearest
            FROM stamp_users su
            JOIN stamp st ON st.id = su.stamp
            JOIN events e ON e.name = st.description
            WHERE su.user != '' AND su.user != '5366'
          ) x
          JOIN positions p ON p.id = x.position
          WHERE x.nearest = 1 AND x.owner != x.user AND NOT x.is_national
            AND x.when_start != ''
            AND julianday(x.when_start) <= julianday('now')
            AND julianday(x.when_start) > julianday('now', '-365 days')
        )
        GROUP BY region, user
      ) a
      JOIN (
        SELECT CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END AS region,
               COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active
        FROM members_registry mr
        WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
        GROUP BY 1
      ) reg ON reg.region = a.region
      CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT AVG(active) AS avg_active FROM (
          SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active FROM members_registry mr
          WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
          GROUP BY CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END)
      ) nb
      GROUP BY a.region
    )
  )
) d ON d.region = CASE lo.region WHEN 'Basilicata e Puglia' THEN 'Puglia' WHEN 'Piemonte e Val d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Emilia Romagna' THEN 'Emilia-Romagna' WHEN 'Friuli Venezia Giulia' THEN 'Friuli-Venezia Giulia' WHEN 'Trentino Alto Adige' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' ELSE lo.region END

name: view_leaderboard_segretari
viewQuery:
-- Classifica dei segretari regionali (local_offices_admins.is_the_officer):
-- ogni segretario vale quanto la sua regione in view_leaderboard_regioni
-- (partecipazione x comunita' + nazionali ospitati, vedi li'). Dove i segretari sono due
-- (Sicilia) hanno lo stesso punteggio e la stessa posizione. Va creata dopo
-- view_leaderboard_regioni.
SELECT
  u.id AS id,
  u.name AS name,
  r.id AS local_office,
  r.region AS region,
  -- come in view_leaderboard_regioni: a pari punti pari posizione,
  -- DENSE_RANK per avere sempre le tre medaglie
  CAST(DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.score DESC) AS INTEGER) AS position,
  CAST(r.score AS INTEGER) AS score,
  CAST(r.participation AS INTEGER) AS participation,
  CAST(r.community_pct AS INTEGER) AS community_pct,
  CAST(r.national_points AS INTEGER) AS national_points,
  CAST(r.national_events AS INTEGER) AS national_events,
  CAST(r.effective_attendees AS INTEGER) AS effective_attendees,
  CAST(r.distinct_attendees AS INTEGER) AS distinct_attendees,
  CAST(r.core_pct AS INTEGER) AS core_pct,
  CAST(r.reach_pct AS INTEGER) AS reach_pct,
  CAST(r.events_total AS INTEGER) AS events_total,
  CAST(r.events_scoring AS INTEGER) AS events_scoring,
  CAST(r.attendance_total AS INTEGER) AS attendance_total,
  CAST(r.members_active AS INTEGER) AS members_active,
  CAST(r.avg_share_pct AS INTEGER) AS avg_share_pct
FROM local_offices_admins la
JOIN users u ON u.id = la.user
JOIN view_leaderboard_regioni r ON r.id = la.local_office
WHERE la.is_the_officer

viewQuery:
SELECT
  u.id AS id,

  u.created AS app_since,
  u.expire_membership AS expire_membership,
  u.is_membership_active AS is_membership_active,
  CAST(u.expire_membership > DATETIME('now', '+365 days') AS BOOL) AS renewed_ahead,

  CAST(COALESCE(s.stamps_total, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_total,
  s.first_stamp_at AS first_stamp_at,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.stamps_months, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_distinct_months,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.stamps_night, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_night,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.stamps_morning, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_morning,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.stamps_halloween, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_halloween,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.stamps_new_year, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_new_year,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.stamps_valentine, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_valentine,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.stamps_pi_day, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_pi_day,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.stamps_birthday, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_birthday,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.stamps_first_day, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_first_day,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.stamps_late, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_late,

  CAST(COALESCE(d.max_same_day, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_max_same_day,
  CAST(COALESCE(ms.max_month_streak, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_max_month_streak,
  CAST(COALESCE(se.max_seasons_in_year, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_max_seasons_in_year,

  CAST(COALESCE(pi.stamps_pioneer, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_pioneer,

  CAST(COALESCE(g.stamp_regions, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_distinct_regions,
  CAST(COALESCE(g.stamps_national, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_national,
  CAST(COALESCE(g.stamps_out_of_region, 0) AS INTEGER) AS stamps_out_of_region,

  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets t WHERE t.user_id = u.id) AS INTEGER) AS tickets_total,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e WHERE e.owner = u.id) AS INTEGER) AS events_created,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e WHERE e.owner = u.id AND e.is_national) AS INTEGER) AS events_created_national,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events_schedule_subscribers es WHERE es.user = u.id) AS INTEGER) AS event_registrations,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments pa WHERE pa.user = u.id AND pa.status = 'succeeded') AS INTEGER) AS payments_succeeded,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments pa WHERE pa.user = u.id AND pa.status = 'succeeded'
          AND LOWER(pa.description) LIKE '%donazion%') AS INTEGER) AS donations,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM boutique_orders bo WHERE bo.user = u.id) AS INTEGER) AS boutique_orders,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users_devices ud WHERE ud.user = u.id) AS INTEGER) AS devices,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM calendar_link cl WHERE cl.user = u.id) > 0 AS BOOL) AS calendar_linked,
  CAST(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(cl.state)) FROM calendar_link cl
          WHERE cl.user = u.id AND JSON_VALID(cl.state)), 0) AS INTEGER) AS calendar_regions

FROM users u

LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    x.user,
    COUNT(*) AS stamps_total,
    MIN(x.created) AS first_stamp_at,
    COUNT(DISTINCT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', x.lt)) AS stamps_months,
    SUM(CAST(STRFTIME('%H', x.lt) AS INTEGER) < 4) AS stamps_night,
    SUM(CAST(STRFTIME('%H', x.lt) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) AS stamps_morning,
    SUM(STRFTIME('%m-%d', x.lt) = '10-31') AS stamps_halloween,
    SUM(STRFTIME('%m-%d', x.lt) IN ('12-31', '01-01')) AS stamps_new_year,
    SUM(STRFTIME('%m-%d', x.lt) = '02-14') AS stamps_valentine,
    SUM(STRFTIME('%m-%d', x.lt) = '03-14') AS stamps_pi_day,
    SUM(mr.birthdate IS NOT NULL AND mr.birthdate != ''
        AND STRFTIME('%m-%d', x.lt) = STRFTIME('%m-%d', DATETIME(mr.birthdate, '+2 hours'))) AS stamps_birthday,
    SUM(JULIANDAY(x.created) - JULIANDAY(x.stamp_created) <= 1) AS stamps_first_day,
    SUM(JULIANDAY(x.created) - JULIANDAY(x.stamp_created) >= 182) AS stamps_late
  FROM (
    SELECT su.user, su.created, DATETIME(su.created, '+2 hours') AS lt, st.created AS stamp_created
    FROM (SELECT su0.id, su0.stamp, su0.user, su0.created FROM stamp_users su0
    -- fuori il timbro di chi ha organizzato l'edizione piu' vicina nel tempo
    -- al timbro, le edizioni di altri, prima o dopo la sua, contano
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stamp st0 JOIN events e0 ON e0.name = st0.description WHERE st0.id = su0.stamp AND e0.owner = su0.user
                      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e1 WHERE e1.name = st0.description AND e1.owner != su0.user
                                      AND abs(julianday(su0.created) - julianday(e1.when_start)) < abs(julianday(su0.created) - julianday(e0.when_start))))
      -- lo staff regionale (local_offices_admins) non conta i timbri degli
      -- eventi non nazionali della propria regione, finche' e' in carica
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stamp sx JOIN events er ON er.name = sx.description JOIN positions pr ON pr.id = er.position
                      JOIN local_offices_admins la ON la.user = su0.user JOIN local_offices lo ON lo.id = la.local_office
                      WHERE sx.id = su0.stamp AND NOT er.is_national
                        AND CASE lo.region WHEN 'Basilicata e Puglia' THEN 'Puglia' WHEN 'Piemonte e Val d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Emilia Romagna' THEN 'Emilia-Romagna' WHEN 'Friuli Venezia Giulia' THEN 'Friuli-Venezia Giulia' WHEN 'Trentino Alto Adige' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' ELSE lo.region END
                            = CASE pr.state WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE pr.state END)
      -- conta solo i timbri che in classifica valgono almeno un punto a
      -- tempo zero (view_leaderboard, senza scadenza ne' comunita'):
      -- 20 * sigma(s) >= 1, con s = timbratori / (N_r^0,7 * Nmedia^0,3),
      -- timbratori esclusi l'organizzatore dell'edizione e 5366, N_r i soci
      -- attivi della regione dell'edizione piu' vicina alla creazione del
      -- timbro (Nmedia se nazionale o senza regione). La soglia e' una
      -- quota dei soci, quindi lo stesso numero di timbratori basta in una
      -- regione piccola e non in una grande.
      AND su0.stamp IN (
        SELECT k.stamp FROM (
          SELECT cs.stamp,
            MIN(1.0, MAX(0.0, (cs.claimers / (POWER(COALESCE(reg.active, nb.avg_active), 0.7) * POWER(nb.avg_active, 0.3)) - 0.02) / 0.13)) AS t
          FROM (
            SELECT stamp, COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS claimers
            FROM (
              SELECT su.stamp, su.user, e.owner,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.id
                                   ORDER BY abs(julianday(su.created) - julianday(e.when_start))) AS nearest
              FROM stamp_users su
              JOIN stamp st ON st.id = su.stamp
              LEFT JOIN events e ON e.name = st.description
              WHERE su.user != '' AND su.user != '5366'
            )
            WHERE nearest = 1 AND COALESCE(owner, '') != user
            GROUP BY stamp
          ) cs
          LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT stamp, position, is_national FROM (
              SELECT st.id AS stamp, e.position, COALESCE(e.is_national, 0) AS is_national,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY st.id
                                   ORDER BY abs(julianday(st.created) - julianday(e.when_start))) AS nearest
              FROM stamp st
              JOIN events e ON e.name = st.description
            )
            WHERE nearest = 1
          ) ne ON ne.stamp = cs.stamp
          LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = ne.position
          LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END AS region,
                   COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active
            FROM members_registry mr
            WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
            GROUP BY 1
          ) reg ON reg.region = CASE p.state WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE p.state END AND NOT COALESCE(ne.is_national, 0)
          CROSS JOIN (
            SELECT AVG(active) AS avg_active FROM (
              SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS active FROM members_registry mr
              WHERE mr.is_active AND mr.area NOT IN ('', 'NaN')
              GROUP BY CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END)
          ) nb
        ) k
        WHERE 20.0 * k.t * k.t * (3 - 2 * k.t) >= 1)) su
    JOIN stamp st ON st.id = su.stamp
  ) x
  LEFT JOIN members_registry mr ON mr.id = x.user
  GROUP BY x.user
) s ON s.user = u.id

LEFT JOIN (

              GROUP BY CASE mr.area WHEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol' THEN 'Trentino-Alto Adige' WHEN 'Valle d''Aosta' THEN 'Piemonte' WHEN 'Basilicata' THEN 'Puglia' ELSE mr.area END)
          ) nb
        ) k
        WHERE 20.0 * k.t * k.t * (3 - 2 * k.t) >= 1)) su
  JOIN stamp st ON st.id = su.stamp
  JOIN events e ON e.name = st.description
  LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = e.position
  LEFT JOIN members_registry mr ON mr.id = su.user
  GROUP BY su.user
) g ON g.user = u.id
